report: Revision field theory (SPEC sections 1-4, 6) for the corrected metric of 2026-10-16 (general a4 and b4; every real z): vielbein, canonical spin connection, Lagrangian, Euler-Lagrange equations, non-triviality [1] and [2], current, energy-momentum tensor, exact solutions, canonical quantisation; both statistics, verified exactly in WolframScript
producer: Revision/theory/wolfram/verify_field_theory.wls (parts base, emt-G, emt-C, solutions, solutions-G, quantisation; merge)
metric: g = diag(E^(-2 a4[x4]) b4[x4] Cot[z]^2, E^(2 a4[x4]) (3 times), -1, -E^(-2 a4[x4]) b4[x4] (Sin[z]^2)^(1/6) (3 times)), z = 6 H x0 real, b4[x4] > 0 and a4[x4] general functions of x4 (Revision/SPEC.md section 1; the corrected metric of 2026-10-16, version 2)
statistics: G = dirac16complex: 16 complex anticommuting components, explicit Grassmann algebra with generators theta_1, theta_2 and their conjugates; C = dirac16complex00: 16 complex commuting components
coordinates: the author's coordinates x0..x7: x0 = the hidden, space-like direction; x1, x2, x3 = 3-space; x4 = time; x5, x6, x7 = the exponentially deflating extra times; z = 6 H x0 takes every real value (-Infinity < z < Infinity), H > 0; Sin[z]^(1/3) = (Sin[z]^2)^(1/6); sqrt|g| = sig f0...f7, sig = sign(Cot z) = +-1

checks.name: zero_test_sanity
checks.detail: the exact zero test (field functions, their derivatives and U-expressions as independent polynomial variables; coefficients in the normal form for EVERY real z: Sin z, Cos z signed, w = (Sin z^2)^(1/12) > 0, reduced modulo Cos^2 + Sin^2 - 1, w^12 - Sin^2 and sig^2 - 1, sig = sign(Cot z)) returns True on identities and False on nonzero expressions in a set of control cases: (Sin z^2)^(1/2) - Sin z and (Sin z^2)^(1/2) + Sin z are NOT zero (no sign of Sin z is assumed), w^12 - Sin^2 and sig^2 - 1 are zero, sig - 1 is not; d0 (Sin z^2)^(1/12) = H Cot z (Sin z^2)^(1/12); b4[x4] and its derivatives are free symbols: Sqrt[b4]^2 - b4 and b4^(3/2)/b4^(1/2) - b4 are zero, b4 - 1 and b4' are not (the test never sets b4 = 1)

checks.name: fixture_Clifford_relation
checks.detail: the gammas read from Revision/algebra/gammas.json satisfy {gamma^a, gamma^b} = 2 eta^ab I16 with eta = diag(1,1,1,1,-1,-1,-1,-1) (order x0..x7), as recorded in the fixture

checks.name: fixture_C_B_S_consistent
checks.detail: C = gamma^(x0) gamma^(x1) gamma^(x2) gamma^(x3) (real symmetric, C^2 = 1, C gamma^a antisymmetric), B = -i C gamma^(x4), Gamma = gamma^(x0) gamma^(x1)...gamma^(x7), S^ab = (1/4)[gamma^a, gamma^b], all as decoded from the fixture

checks.name: metric_is_the_corrected_metric
checks.detail: g = e^T eta e with the diagonal vielbein e^a_mu = f_a delta^a_mu, f(x0) = E^-a4 b4^(1/2) Cot[z] (signed), f(x1,x2,x3) = E^a4, f(x4) = 1, f(x5,x6,x7) = E^-a4 b4^(1/2) (Sin[z]^2)^(1/12), z = 6 H x0, reproduces the corrected metric of SPEC section 1 entry by entry, for general functions a4(x4) and b4(x4) > 0 and every real z, and the record of Revision/metric_warped (key metric_corrected) states the same metric

checks.name: vielbein_inverse
checks.detail: e^a_mu e_a^nu = delta and e_a^mu e_b^nu eta^ab = g^munu (inverse vielbein e_a^mu = delta_a^mu / f_a)

checks.name: sqrt_det_g
checks.detail: det g = E^(-2 a4) b4^4 Cot[z]^2 (Sin[z]^2)^(1/2) >= 0 (four negative entries), f0...f7 = E^-a4 b4^2 Cot[z] (Sin[z]^2)^(1/4), so sqrt|det g| = sig f0...f7 = E^-a4 b4^2 |Cot z| (Sin z^2)^(1/4) with sig = sign(Cot z) = +-1, constant on every interval n Pi/2 < z < (n + 1) Pi/2 (the metric degenerates at z = n Pi/2: g00 = 0 where Cos z = 0, g_tt = 0 where Sin z = 0); sqrt g^2 = det g; d_x4 sqrt|g| = (2 b4'/b4 - a4') sqrt|g| and d_x0 sqrt|g| = -3 H (2 Tan z + Cot z) sqrt|g|. Every field equation and every T^mu_nu below is independent of sig (they are homogeneous of degree 0 in sqrt g)

checks.name: degenerate_at_H_0
checks.detail: at fixed x0 != 0 and H -> 0+ the entries g55 = g66 = g77 -> 0 (for every b4 > 0) and g00 -> infinity: H = 0 is not a metric of the family (a degenerate limit); every statement below assumes H > 0

checks.name: christoffel_count
checks.detail: the Levi-Civita connection has 21 independent nonzero symbols Gamma^l_mn (m <= n): Gamma^x0_(x0 x0), Gamma^x0_(x0 x4), Gamma^x0_(xt xt) (3), Gamma^xi_(xi x4) (3), Gamma^x4_(x0 x0), Gamma^x4_(xi xi) (3), Gamma^x4_(xt xt) (3), Gamma^xt_(xt x0) (3), Gamma^xt_(xt x4) (3); the hidden and extra-time ones contain b4'/b4; listed in field-theory.json (christoffel_nonzero)

checks.name: ricci_scalar
checks.detail: Ricci scalar R = g^sn R^r_srn = -12 Cb + 8 a4'^2 - 2 a4'' - 8 a4' b4'/b4 + 4 b4''/b4 + (b4'/b4)^2, Cb = H^2 E^(2 a4)/b4, independent of x0 (convention R^r_smn = d_m Gamma^r_ns - d_n Gamma^r_ms + Gamma^r_ml Gamma^l_ns - Gamma^r_nl Gamma^l_ms)

checks.name: ricci_mixed_components
checks.detail: R^mu_nu is DIAGONAL (no off-diagonal component; the metric of 2026-10-14 had R^x4_x0 = (3/2) H Cot[z] b4'/b4) and independent of x0: R^x0_x0 = R^xt_xt = -3 Cb + a4'^2 - a4'' - (5/2) a4' b4'/b4 + (1/2) b4''/b4 + (1/2)(b4'/b4)^2 (t = 5, 6, 7; the hidden direction and the extra times form one block), R^xi_xi = -a4'^2 + a4'' + 2 a4' b4'/b4 (i = 1, 2, 3), R^x4_x4 = 7 a4'^2 - a4'' - 4 a4' b4'/b4 + 2 b4''/b4 - (b4'/b4)^2, Cb = H^2 E^(2 a4)/b4; R^mu_nu and R equal the independent sympy record Revision/metric_warped/results/warped-metric.json (keys ricci_mixed_diagonal_mathematica, ricci_scalar_mathematica)

checks.name: flat_member_and_curvature
checks.detail: the corrected metric is FLAT for a4 = 0, b4 = H^2 x4^2 (all 4096 R^r_smn vanish: 8-dimensional flat space in Milne form, the block of curvature -H^2 scaled by H x4), so unlike the metric of 2026-10-14 (R^x0_x0 = -6 H^2) it is not curved for every a4, b4; on the record's history a4 = H x4, b4 = E^(4 H x4/3) R != 0 (curved). This replaces the check never_flat_for_H_positive of the metric of 2026-10-14

checks.name: vielbein_postulate
checks.detail: d_mu e^a_nu - Gamma^l_mu,nu e^a_l + omega_mu^a_b e^b_nu = 0 for all 512 components, with omega_mu^a_b = e^a_nu (d_mu e_b^nu + Gamma^nu_mu,l e_b^l)

checks.name: omega_antisymmetric
checks.detail: omega_mu,ab = eta_ac omega_mu^c_b = -omega_mu,ba (metric compatibility)

checks.name: omega_components
checks.detail: exactly 10 independent nonzero omega_mu,ab (a < b in the order x0..x7), with h4 = b4'/(2 b4) - a4' = (d/dx4) ln(E^-a4 b4^(1/2)) and sb = E^-a4 b4^(1/2): omega_x0,(x0)(x4) = h4 sb Cot[z] (the hidden direction now follows the extra times in x4); for i = x1, x2, x3: omega_i,(i)(x4) = a4' E^a4 (no x0 part: 3-space does not depend on x0); for t = x5, x6, x7: omega_t,(x4)(t) = h4 sb (Sin[z]^2)^(1/12) and omega_t,(x0)(t) = H (Sin[z]^2)^(1/12); omega_x4 = 0. These are omega_c,(c)(b) = eta_cc (d_b f_c)/f_b for the diagonal vielbein; every component is h4, a4' or H times a factor that does not vanish between the degenerate points z = n Pi/2

checks.name: Omega_components
checks.detail: Omega_mu = (1/2) omega_mu,ab S^ab = sum_(a<b) omega_mu,ab (1/2) gamma^a gamma^b: Omega_x0 = (1/2) h4 sb Cot[z] gamma^(x0) gamma^(x4); Omega_xi = (1/2) a4' E^a4 gamma^(xi) gamma^(x4) for i = 1, 2, 3; Omega_xt = (1/2) (Sin[z]^2)^(1/12) (h4 sb gamma^(x4) gamma^(xt) + H gamma^(x0) gamma^(xt)) for t = 5, 6, 7; Omega_x4 = 0 (f4 = 1); Omega_x0 != 0

checks.name: gamma_covariantly_constant
checks.detail: D_mu gamma^nu = d_mu gamma^nu + Gamma^nu_mu,l gamma^l + [Omega_mu, gamma^nu] = 0 for all 64 (mu, nu), gamma^nu = e_a^nu gamma^a (the canonical connection is the one that makes the gammas covariantly constant)

checks.name: S_rotates_gamma_with_omega
checks.detail: [Omega_mu, gamma^c] = -omega_mu^c_b gamma^b (the frame form of covariant constancy)

checks.name: spin_curvature_equals_Riemann
checks.detail: [D_mu, D_nu] Psi = (d_mu Omega_nu - d_nu Omega_mu + [Omega_mu, Omega_nu]) Psi = (1/2) R_ab,mu,nu S^ab Psi with R_ab,mu,nu = eta_aa e^a_r R^r_s,mu,nu e_b^s, all 28 pairs: the integrability (compatibility) condition of the spinor connection; it also shows that Omega cannot vanish in any frame unless the Riemann tensor vanishes (flat space)

checks.name: gammaOmega_total
checks.detail: gamma^mu Omega_mu = (3/2) H E^a4 b4^(-1/2) gamma^(x0) + (b4'/b4 - a4'/2) gamma^(x4) exactly, independent of x0 for every real z and equal to the independent sympy record Revision/metric_warped/results/warped-metric.json (key dirac_gravity_term); in the metric of 2026-10-14 it was 3 H gamma^(x0) + (3/4)(b4'/b4) gamma^(x4)

checks.name: gammaOmega_per_direction
checks.detail: per direction (no sum): gamma^(x0) Omega_x0 = (h4/2) gamma^(x4); gamma^(xi) Omega_xi = (a4'/2) gamma^(x4) for each 3-space direction i = 1, 2, 3; gamma^(xt) Omega_xt = (h4/2) gamma^(x4) + (H/2) E^a4 b4^(-1/2) gamma^(x0) for each extra time t = 5, 6, 7; gamma^(x4) Omega_x4 = 0 (h4 = b4'/(2 b4) - a4'). Sum: gamma^(x4) coefficient 4 (h4/2) + 3 (a4'/2) = b4'/b4 - a4'/2 (the four directions of the hidden block x0, x5, x6, x7 share the rate h4); gamma^(x0) coefficient 3 (H/2) E^a4 b4^(-1/2) from the three extra times

checks.name: gammaOmega_divergence_form
checks.detail: {gamma^mu, Omega_mu} = 0 for each mu separately (Omega_mu contains only S^(mu b)), hence gamma^mu Omega_mu = (1/(2 sqrt g)) d_mu (sqrt g gamma^mu) (sig cancels); for this metric (1/(2 sqrt g)) d_x0 (sqrt g/f0) gamma^(x0) = (1/(2 sqrt g)) d_x0 (sig b4^(3/2) (Sin z^2)^(1/4)) gamma^(x0) = (3/2) H E^a4 b4^(-1/2) gamma^(x0) and (1/(2 sqrt g)) d_x4 (sqrt g) gamma^(x4) = (b4'/b4 - a4'/2) gamma^(x4)

checks.name: grassmann_algebra_structure
checks.detail: explicit Grassmann algebra on theta_1, theta_2, thetabar_1, thetabar_2: theta_i theta_j = -theta_j theta_i, theta_i^2 = 0, conj(theta_1 theta_2) = thetabar_2 thetabar_1, conj conj = id; Psi_A = sum_k ph[A,k](x) theta_k; L has components only on thetabar_k theta_l (bilinear) and theta_1 theta_2 thetabar_1 thetabar_2 (quartic); S = Psibar Psi is even with S^2 != 0 and S^3 = 0, so U = u1 S + (lam/2) S^2 is the most general potential

checks.name: L_real_G
checks.detail: L* = L exactly for dirac16complex (Grassmann) (the involution reverses the order of Grassmann factors; U = u1 S + (lam/2) S^2 with real u1, lam): C real symmetric, C gamma^a real antisymmetric and S^T C + C S = 0 make the symmetrised kinetic term and Psibar Psi real without a factor i

checks.name: L_real_C
checks.detail: L* = L exactly for dirac16complex00 (commuting) (ph <-> phc, i -> -i; U a real function): C real symmetric, C gamma^a real antisymmetric and S^T C + C S = 0 make the symmetrised kinetic term and Psibar Psi real without a factor i

checks.name: L_total_divergence_to_unsymmetrised_G
checks.detail: L = sqrt g [Psibar gamma^mu D_mu Psi - m S - U] - (1/2) d_mu (sqrt g Psibar gamma^mu Psi) exactly, for dirac16complex (Grassmann): the two forms differ by a total divergence and give the same field equations

checks.name: L_total_divergence_to_unsymmetrised_C
checks.detail: L = sqrt g [Psibar gamma^mu D_mu Psi - m S - U] - (1/2) d_mu (sqrt g Psibar gamma^mu Psi) exactly, for dirac16complex00 (commuting): the two forms differ by a total divergence and give the same field equations

checks.name: L_spin_connection_drops_out_G
checks.detail: for this diagonal metric Psibar {gamma^mu, Omega_mu} Psi = 0 term by term, so L = sqrt g [(1/2)(Psibar gamma^mu d_mu Psi - d_mu Psibar gamma^mu Psi) - m S - U] exactly (dirac16complex (Grassmann)); the canonical spin connection reaches the field equations through d_mu(sqrt g gamma^mu) = 2 sqrt g gamma^mu Omega_mu (variation of the derivative terms), and the unsymmetrised form contains it explicitly

checks.name: L_spin_connection_drops_out_C
checks.detail: for this diagonal metric Psibar {gamma^mu, Omega_mu} Psi = 0 term by term, so L = sqrt g [(1/2)(Psibar gamma^mu d_mu Psi - d_mu Psibar gamma^mu Psi) - m S - U] exactly (dirac16complex00 (commuting)); the canonical spin connection reaches the field equations through d_mu(sqrt g gamma^mu) = 2 sqrt g gamma^mu Omega_mu (variation of the derivative terms), and the unsymmetrised form contains it explicitly

checks.name: EL_Psibar_G
checks.detail: for every A = 1..16 and k = 1, 2: dL/dphc[A,k] - d_mu dL/d(d_mu phc[A,k]) = thetabar_k sqrt g (C E)_A with E = gamma^mu D_mu Psi - (m + U'(S)) Psi, U'(S) = u1 + lam S (explicit Grassmann algebra): the field equation is gamma^mu D_mu Psi = (m + U'(S)) Psi

checks.name: EL_Psi_G
checks.detail: for every A, k: dL/dph[A,k] - d_mu dL/d(d_mu ph[A,k]) = theta_k sqrt g Ebar_A with Ebar = (D_mu Psibar) gamma^mu + (m + U'(S)) Psibar (sign from moving theta_k to the left): the adjoint equation (D_mu Psibar) gamma^mu = -(m + U'(S)) Psibar

checks.name: EL_Psibar_C
checks.detail: for every A = 1..16: dL/dPhi*_A - d_mu dL/d(d_mu Phi*_A) = sqrt g (C E)_A with E = gamma^mu D_mu Phi - (m + U'(S)) Phi (general U): the field equation is gamma^mu D_mu Phi = (m + U'(S)) Phi

checks.name: EL_Psi_C
checks.detail: for every A: dL/dPhi_A - d_mu dL/d(d_mu Phi_A) = -sqrt g Ebar_A with Ebar = (D_mu Phibar) gamma^mu + (m + U'(S)) Phibar: the adjoint equation (D_mu Phibar) gamma^mu = -(m + U'(S)) Phibar

checks.name: adjoint_equation_is_Dirac_conjugate_G
checks.detail: E^dagger C = -Ebar exactly for dirac16complex (Grassmann) (uses C gamma^a C = -(gamma^a)^T, Omega^T C = -C Omega, U' real): the adjoint equation is the Dirac conjugate of the field equation

checks.name: adjoint_equation_is_Dirac_conjugate_C
checks.detail: E^dagger C = -Ebar exactly for dirac16complex00 (commuting) (uses C gamma^a C = -(gamma^a)^T, Omega^T C = -C Omega, U' real): the adjoint equation is the Dirac conjugate of the field equation

checks.name: Dirac_operator_explicit_G
checks.detail: gamma^mu D_mu Psi = E^a4 b4^(-1/2) Tan[z] gamma^(x0) d0 Psi + E^-a4 (gamma^(x1) d1 + gamma^(x2) d2 + gamma^(x3) d3) Psi + gamma^(x4) d4 Psi + E^a4 b4^(-1/2) (Sin[z]^2)^(-1/12) (gamma^(x5) d5 + gamma^(x6) d6 + gamma^(x7) d7) Psi + (3/2) H E^a4 b4^(-1/2) gamma^(x0) Psi + (b4'/b4 - a4'/2) gamma^(x4) Psi, for dirac16complex (Grassmann) (the hidden-direction terms E^a4 b4^(-1/2) (Tan[z] d0 + (3/2) H) gamma^(x0) carry the inverse scale factor of the hidden block)

checks.name: Dirac_operator_explicit_C
checks.detail: gamma^mu D_mu Psi = E^a4 b4^(-1/2) Tan[z] gamma^(x0) d0 Psi + E^-a4 (gamma^(x1) d1 + gamma^(x2) d2 + gamma^(x3) d3) Psi + gamma^(x4) d4 Psi + E^a4 b4^(-1/2) (Sin[z]^2)^(-1/12) (gamma^(x5) d5 + gamma^(x6) d6 + gamma^(x7) d7) Psi + (3/2) H E^a4 b4^(-1/2) gamma^(x0) Psi + (b4'/b4 - a4'/2) gamma^(x4) Psi, for dirac16complex00 (commuting) (the hidden-direction terms E^a4 b4^(-1/2) (Tan[z] d0 + (3/2) H) gamma^(x0) carry the inverse scale factor of the hidden block)

checks.name: block_form
checks.detail: every gamma^a = {{0, tb_a}, {t_a, 0}} is block off-diagonal in the chiral split Psi = (psi_-, psi_+) (Gamma = diag(-1, 1)): the field equation is the pair sum_a (1/f_a) tb_a d_a psi_+ + cg tb_0 psi_+ + vg tb_4 psi_+ = V psi_- and sum_a (1/f_a) t_a d_a psi_- + cg t_0 psi_- + vg t_4 psi_- = V psi_+, cg = (3/2) H E^a4 b4^(-1/2), vg = b4'/b4 - a4'/2 (blocks in field-theory.json)

checks.name: evolution_form_G
checks.detail: (gamma^(x4))^2 = -1, so the field equation is equivalent to the first-order evolution equation d4 Psi = -gamma^(x4) [(m + U'(S)) Psi - sum_(a != x4) (1/f_a) gamma^(a) d_a Psi - (3/2) H E^a4 b4^(-1/2) gamma^(x0) Psi] - (b4'/b4 - a4'/2) Psi (exact: gamma^(x4) (d4 Psi - RHS) = E; the last term is the factor E^(a4/2) b4^(-1) of the solutions): the slices x4 = const are non-characteristic (g^44 = -1 != 0), dirac16complex (Grassmann)

checks.name: evolution_form_C
checks.detail: (gamma^(x4))^2 = -1, so the field equation is equivalent to the first-order evolution equation d4 Psi = -gamma^(x4) [(m + U'(S)) Psi - sum_(a != x4) (1/f_a) gamma^(a) d_a Psi - (3/2) H E^a4 b4^(-1/2) gamma^(x0) Psi] - (b4'/b4 - a4'/2) Psi (exact: gamma^(x4) (d4 Psi - RHS) = E; the last term is the factor E^(a4/2) b4^(-1) of the solutions): the slices x4 = const are non-characteristic (g^44 = -1 != 0), dirac16complex00 (commuting)

checks.name: nontriviality_1_dirac16complex
checks.detail: NON-TRIVIALITY [1] for dirac16complex (Grassmann): the spin-connection part of the Euler-Lagrange equation is exactly (gamma^mu D_mu - gamma^mu d_mu) Psi = gamma^mu Omega_mu Psi = G Psi with G = cg gamma^(x0) + vg gamma^(x4), cg = (3/2) H E^a4 b4^(-1/2), vg = b4'/b4 - a4'/2, nonzero for every H > 0 and all functions a4, b4 (cg > 0); G^2 = (cg^2 - vg^2) I16 = ((9/4) H^2 E^(2 a4)/b4 - (b4'/b4 - a4'/2)^2) I16, so G Psi != 0 for every Psi != 0 wherever cg^2 != vg^2 (on the record's history a4 = H x4, b4 = E^(4 H x4/3): cg = (3/2) H E^(H x4/3), vg = (5/6) H, G^2 = H^2 ((9/4) E^(2 H x4/3) - 25/36) > 0); in addition the vielbein enters every derivative term, gamma^mu d_mu = E^a4 b4^(-1/2) Tan[z] gamma^(x0) d0 + E^-a4 gamma^(xi) d_i + gamma^(x4) d4 + E^a4 b4^(-1/2) (Sin[z]^2)^(-1/12) gamma^(xt) d_t (none of the factors is identically 1). All gravitational terms vanish together only if Omega_mu = 0 for all mu (check Omega_vanishes_iff_a4prime_b4prime_and_H_vanish), which by spin_curvature_equals_Riemann requires a flat metric (the corrected metric is flat only for special a4, b4, check flat_member_and_curvature; H = 0 is a degenerate limit, check degenerate_at_H_0)

checks.name: nontriviality_2_dirac16complex00
checks.detail: NON-TRIVIALITY [2] for dirac16complex00 (commuting): the spin-connection part of the Euler-Lagrange equation is exactly (gamma^mu D_mu - gamma^mu d_mu) Psi = gamma^mu Omega_mu Psi = G Psi with G = cg gamma^(x0) + vg gamma^(x4), cg = (3/2) H E^a4 b4^(-1/2), vg = b4'/b4 - a4'/2, nonzero for every H > 0 and all functions a4, b4 (cg > 0); G^2 = (cg^2 - vg^2) I16 = ((9/4) H^2 E^(2 a4)/b4 - (b4'/b4 - a4'/2)^2) I16, so G Psi != 0 for every Psi != 0 wherever cg^2 != vg^2 (on the record's history a4 = H x4, b4 = E^(4 H x4/3): cg = (3/2) H E^(H x4/3), vg = (5/6) H, G^2 = H^2 ((9/4) E^(2 H x4/3) - 25/36) > 0); in addition the vielbein enters every derivative term, gamma^mu d_mu = E^a4 b4^(-1/2) Tan[z] gamma^(x0) d0 + E^-a4 gamma^(xi) d_i + gamma^(x4) d4 + E^a4 b4^(-1/2) (Sin[z]^2)^(-1/12) gamma^(xt) d_t (none of the factors is identically 1). All gravitational terms vanish together only if Omega_mu = 0 for all mu (check Omega_vanishes_iff_a4prime_b4prime_and_H_vanish), which by spin_curvature_equals_Riemann requires a flat metric (the corrected metric is flat only for special a4, b4, check flat_member_and_curvature; H = 0 is a degenerate limit, check degenerate_at_H_0)

checks.name: Omega_vanishes_iff_a4prime_b4prime_and_H_vanish
checks.detail: each of the 10 nonzero omega_mu,ab is h4 = b4'/(2 b4) - a4', a4' or H times one of the factors E^a4, E^-a4 b4^(1/2) Cot[z], E^-a4 b4^(1/2) (Sin[z]^2)^(1/12), (Sin[z]^2)^(1/12), none of which vanishes between the degenerate points z = n Pi/2: the x4-part of Omega_xi (3-space) vanishes iff a4 is constant, the x4-parts of Omega_x0 and Omega_xt (the hidden block) iff E^-a4 b4^(1/2) is constant, and the H-part of Omega_xt iff H = 0; so all x4-parts vanish iff a4 and b4 are both constant, and for H > 0 the spin connection never vanishes

checks.name: current_real_G
checks.detail: J^mu = -i Psibar gamma^mu Psi is real (Hermitian) for dirac16complex (Grassmann) (-i C gamma^a is Hermitian)

checks.name: current_conservation_identity_G
checks.detail: d_mu (sqrt g J^mu) = -i sqrt g (Ebar Psi + Psibar E) exactly (off shell), so nabla_mu J^mu = 0 on shell, for dirac16complex (Grassmann)

checks.name: charge_density_is_Krein_form_G
checks.detail: J^(x4) = Psi^dagger B Psi with B = -i C gamma^(x4) (Hermitian, signature (8,8)): the charge Q = integral of sqrt g Psi^dagger B Psi d^7x (sqrt g = E^-a4 b4^2 |Cot z| (Sin z^2)^(1/4)) over a slice x4 = const is an indefinite form, dirac16complex (Grassmann) (only the local law d_mu (sqrt g J^mu) = 0 on shell is proved; Q is constant in x4 only if no charge flows through the boundary of the slice, which at the degenerate points z = n Pi/2 is an ASSUMED no-flux condition that this record does not impose)

checks.name: current_real_C
checks.detail: J^mu = -i Psibar gamma^mu Psi is real (Hermitian) for dirac16complex00 (commuting) (-i C gamma^a is Hermitian)

checks.name: no_positive_inner_product
checks.detail: B is Hermitian with eigenvalues +1 (8 times) and -1 (8 times); for the exact unit vector u = {0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, (-I)/Sqrt[2], 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1/Sqrt[2]} (B u = -u) the smeared operator X = sum_A u_A^* Psi_A(f) has {X, X^dagger} = (u^dagger B u) ||f||^2 = -||f||^2. If Psi^dagger were the adjoint in a space with positive inner product, {X, X^dagger} = X X^dagger + X^dagger X would be a positive operator (<phi|{X,X^dagger}|phi> = ||X^dagger phi||^2 + ||X phi||^2 >= 0): contradiction. Hence the canonical anticommutator in signature (4,4) forces an indefinite (Krein) inner product; the positive representation uses the Hilbert adjoint chi = Psi^dagger B with {Psi_A, chi_C} = (B B)_AC = delta_AC

checks.detail: frozen-coefficient (flat-frame) plane waves Psi = u exp(i k.x - i E x4): E u = h_k u with h_k = m beta + sum_a k_a alpha^a, beta = -i gamma^(x4), alpha^a = -gamma^(x4) gamma^a (k_a the momenta in the orthonormal frame); beta and alpha^(x0,x1,x2,x3) are Hermitian, alpha^(x5,x6,x7) anti-Hermitian, {alpha^a, alpha^b} = 2 delta^ab (-eta^44 eta^aa), {alpha, beta} = 0, beta^2 = 1; h_k^2 = (m^2 + k0^2 + k1^2 + k2^2 + k3^2 - k5^2 - k6^2 - k7^2) I, Tr h_k = 0. In the GOOD SECTOR (k5 = k6 = k7 = 0, nothing depends on the extra times) h_k is Hermitian with real eigenvalues +-E (8 each); with extra-time momentum E^2 = m^2 + k_s^2 - k_t^2 is negative for k_t^2 > m^2 + k_s^2: those modes grow exponentially in x4

checks.name: good_sector_hermiticity_curved
checks.detail: the curved mode operator h = m (-i gamma^(x4)) + sum_(a != x4) (1/f_a) i gamma^(x4) gamma^(a) d_a + i cg gamma^(x4) gamma^(x0) - i vg, cg = (3/2) H E^a4 b4^(-1/2), vg = b4'/b4 - a4'/2 (i d4 Psi = h Psi for U = 0; the last term is anti-Hermitian) satisfies, for general u, v and every real z, sqrt g (u^dagger h v - (h u)^dagger v) = sum_(a = x0,x1,x2,x3) d_a (sqrt g/f_a u^dagger M_a v) + sum_(t = x5,x6,x7) (sqrt g/f_t)(u^dagger M_t d_t v - d_t u^dagger M_t v) - i (d_x4 sqrt g) u^dagger v, M_a = i gamma^(x4) gamma^(a), d_x4 sqrt g = 2 vg sqrt g: the anti-Hermitian term exactly compensates the x4 dependence of the measure, so in the GOOD SECTOR (no extra-time dependence) d/dx4 integral sqrt g u^dagger v d^7x = boundary terms for solutions u, v. The x0 term carries sqrt g/f0 = sig b4^(3/2) (Sin z^2)^(1/4): its boundary term vanishes where Sin z = 0 and not where Cos z = 0, so Hermiticity needs a boundary condition at the degenerate points z = Pi/2 + n Pi (see Revision/theory/reports/wolfram-scope.json); without the spin-connection term cg gamma^(x0) a remainder -2 cg sqrt g u^dagger M_0 v survives ((Sin z^2)^(1/4) [p (d0 + (3/2) H Cot z) q + ((d0 + (3/2) H Cot z) p) q] = d0 ((Sin z^2)^(1/4) p q)): for this measure and the variables Psi the gravitational term is what makes the hidden-direction operator formally antisymmetric

checks.name: Krein_form_conserved_curved
checks.detail: sqrt g (u^dagger B h v - (h u)^dagger B v) = sum_(a != 4) d_a (sqrt g/f_a u^dagger B M_a v) - i (d_x4 sqrt g) u^dagger B v for general u, v (all seven slice directions; every real z): for solutions d/dx4 integral sqrt g u^dagger B v d^7x = boundary terms, i.e. the Krein form integral sqrt g u^dagger B v d^7x is conserved in the whole theory up to these boundary terms (they need boundary conditions, in particular at the degenerate points z = n Pi/2)
